ItemID: 1; Title: 335PCS Self Tapping Screws 410 Stainless Steel #8#10 Self Drilling Screws TEK Head Sheet Metal Screws, Wafer Head & Hex Washer for Metal, Wood, Plastic, Car and Furniture; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Useful for my metal repair projects, though I already have some self-tapping screws.

ItemID: 4; Title: EDSRDXS 24PCS Super Glue Always Keep Fresh Mini Single Use Tubes for Bonding Plastic, Metal, Ceramic, Wood, Glass, Rubber, etc.; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Small tubes would be handy for occasional repairs alongside my epoxy and adhesive tapes.
